model_identity: Record actual repository/revision or deployment weight identity, tokenizer and service configuration; alias alone insufficient
preflight: Fixed small development-only sample before full production; check full-input preservation, token length, format, mapping specificity and omitted mentions; no accuracy-based acceptance
span_contract: Unicode code-point offsets, half-open [start,end) against the unmodified parsed_explanation, plus exact quote; preserve raw response separately
attempt_policy: Bounded retry for transport or structural errors within the same task; retain every attempt; never retry based on diagnostic correctness
review_policy: Preserve initial extraction, changes, reasons and model config; distinguish model review and human review
outcomes: Private reference diagnosis and per-patient outcome fields never enter generation, extraction or review requests
messages_policy: Use all frozen display texts and the shared four-label vocabulary; no patient IDs, subject IDs, split, provenance, hidden facts or outcome sidecars in messages; store exact sent messages
